jobs.occupation: Team Lead (f/m/d) Agentic Shopfloor Bridge (Data Engineer)
jobs.description: Are you passionate about making AI agents work on the real shop floor? Join our operations team and lead the Shopfloor Bridge, the link between the digital world of AI agents and the reality of our factories. You will make sure that agents work technically and functionally in the plants, connect the central agent engineering with factory processes, and guide the start factories from first pilot to routine operation across our global network of 20 factories.What we offer you - An attractive remuneration package- Access to Siemens share plans- 30 days of paid vacation and a variety of flexible work schedules that allow time off for you and your family- Flexible training opportunities for both your professional and personal development that you can tailor to your interests- Barrier-free locationsSince each of over 300,000 team members feels that other benefits are particularly important, and we cannot list our entire benefit portfolio here, you can find more information here (https://www.siemens.com/de/en/company/jobs/benefits-what-we-offer.html) .  The individual benefits are subject to regulatory, contractual, or corporate conditions. You’ll make a difference by-  You build and lead an interdisciplinary team of domain experts, OT and integration specialists, and rollout engineers who connect factory processes with the central Agent Foundry.- You are accountable for ensuring that AI agents work technically and functionally in the factories of the operations AI agent program.- You validate agents in the factory context (test them with maintenance, quality, production control and logistics experts against real shop-floor requirements) and integrate them with MES, ERP and machine systems.- You own the factory-side integration together with the Agent Foundry (APIs, events, data access, reusable system adapters for similar plants, and the shared data model for the most important production objects such as order, machine, disruption, batch and quality deviation), and you lead the rollout in the start factories (support from the first day until routine operation, coordinate with plant managers, local IT/OT contacts and agent champions, and prepare the decision gates for each rollout wave).- You build strong ties between the central teams and the local IT, OT and AI community, and support the rotation of local developers into the central teams to bring plant knowledge into the domain pods.- You work with Procurement, Legal and Security to assess external technology partners and pilots from the technical and operational side.- You ensure that changes on the shop floor are validated, safe and stable, and continuously improve the rollout model based on evidence from the factories.Your defining qualities-  You have many years of experience in manufacturing and production planning, combined with technology management and industrial transformation, and a PhD in a relevant field.- You have proven leadership experience in an industrial environment, and you are ready to take on disciplinary leadership responsibility as the team grows.- You have a track record of turning technology into scalable industrial applications with measurable manufacturing impact, ideally at the interface of OT, MES and production systems, and a strong understanding of manufacturing from the shop floor up, combined with hands-on experience in industrial AI, automation, robotics and digitalization.- You have experience in taking solutions from concept and pilot through industrialization and scale, including the handover to plant organizations and their daily operation.- You are a strategic thinker combined with a strong execution mindset, engage confidently with senior management, technical experts and factory organizations, and can explain trade-offs clearly to each of them.- You have experience in international, cross-functional environments, and you work well in ambiguous situations where direction is still emerging and communicate effectively across cultures.- Willingness to travel regularly to our factories, especially in the early phase of the rollout, and proficiency in English and German complete your profile.You are much more than your qualifications, and we believe in the potential of every single candidate. We look forward to getting to know you!At Siemens, we believe that feeling valued and included is the foundation for doing great work. That’s why we aim to create an inclusive workplace where everyone feels a sense of belonging, and where individual perspectives and experiences are celebrated. Our commitment to fairness and respect extends to every applicant. As an equal opportunity employer (http://www.siemens.com/global/en/company/sustainability/social-commitments/belonging.html) , we welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds and particularly encourage applications from persons with disabilities. About usAt Smart Infrastructure Electrification & Automation our mission is to develop innovative and sustainable solutions that save energy and reduce the carbon footprint of buildings, infrastructure, and industries. We enable the transition to a sustainable energy system, while ensuring a reliable and affordable energy supply. That's why we are committed to creating a greener future and transforming the way we live and work.www.siemens.de/careers (http://www.siemens.com/de/en/company/jobs.html) – if you would like to find out more about jobs & careers at Siemens. jobs.occupation: Technical Product Lifecycle Manager (f/m/d) Gas-insulated Switchgears (Ingenieur/in - Elektrotechnik)
jobs.employer_name: Siemens Energy Global GmbH & Co. KG
jobs.description: A Snapshot of Your Day As a Technical Product Lifecycle Manager (f/m/d), your day combines hands-on technical product care with portfolio-wide decision-making. You will start by clarifying standards or compliance topics with Engineering, translating changed IEC (International Electrotechnical Commission) requirements into configuration rules and assessing their impact on existing projects. You will align with Procurement, factories, Service, and Quality on various technical issues, ensuring appropriate follow-up. Additionally, you will assess portfolio customizations and variances, steering technical tools and product data, and preparing topics for R&D prioritization. Your day will conclude by aligning longer-term technology needs with System Architects and Innovation Management, translating them into a technology roadmap that supports the future GIS (Gas Insulated Switchgear) portfolio.How You’ll Make an Impact * Act as the central technical interface within the GIS PLM team for the gas-insulated high-voltage switchgear portfolio* Maintain a deep technical understanding of GIS products, modules, interfaces, configurations, and applications throughout the product lifecycle* Provide technical guidance and training for PLM, Sales, and Operations, supporting critical customer and project topics* Coordinate the cross-functional solution of complex technical product and field issues, driving sustainable, portfolio-wide solutions* Ensure consistent documentation and transfer of technical decisions, configuration rules, drawings, test evidence, and lessons learned to relevant organizations* Support the handover of vintage products and their components from serial production to the Service organizationWhat You Bring* University degree in electrical engineering, mechanical engineering, power engineering, or a comparable technical discipline* Several years of professional experience with gas-insulated high-voltage switchgear, preferably in product engineering, R&D, project engineering, commissioning, service, or technical product management* Strong knowledge of GIS design, components, interfaces, configuration principles, dielectric and mechanical requirements, testing, and relevant international standards* Experience in structured requirements management, technical documentation, risk assessment, and cross-functional problem solving* Proactive, structured, decisive, and results-oriented working style, combined with strong ownership, collaboration, and stakeholder-management skills* Excellent communication and presentation skills in English; German language skills are an advantageAbout the TeamOur Grid Technology division enables a reliable, sustainable, and digital grid. The power grid is the backbone of the energy transition. Siemens Energy offers a leading portfolio and solutions in HVDC transmission, grid stabilization and storage, high voltage switchgears and transformers, and digital grid technology.Who is Siemens Energy? At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.      Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideoOur Commitment to Diversity Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences. Rewards/Benefits * In addition to an attractive remuneration package in line with the market, you can expect an attractive employer-financed company pension scheme* We also offer the opportunity to become a Siemens Energy shareholder* We offer our employees the opportunity to work flexibly and remotely, and our inspiring offices provide space for collaboration and creativity* The professional and personal development of our employees is very important to us. We provide them with the opportunities to learn and develop in a self-determined way, various attractive programmes and learning materials are available for this purpose* In relation to the "compatibility of family and work", we have a wide range of offers, e.g. flexible working time models, childcare places at many locations, the possibility of trial part-time work or even a sabbatical We value equal opportunities and welcome applications from people with disabilities.https://jobs.siemens-energy.com/jobs

Working closely with project management, customers, suppliers, and engineering interfaces, you will contribute to the delivery of robust and cost-effective solutions.How You’ll Make an Impact * Planning, design, and engineering of auxiliary power systems, including medium- and low-voltage distribution, transformers, emergency diesel generators, and AC/DC power supply systems* Development and review of power supply concepts, electrical load lists, technical specifications, calculations, and power balance analyses* Coordination of technical interfaces with customers, suppliers, and multidisciplinary engineering teams, including automation, mechanical engineering, and building services* Ensuring compliance with project requirements, applicable standards, safety regulations, and technical documentation requirements* Technical evaluation of supplier bids and documentation, as well as support for factory testing, acceptance testing, and commissioning activities* Support of bid preparation and project execution through technical concept development, cost estimation, risk and opportunity management, and timely delivery of engineering work packages to the required quality standardsWhat You Bring* University degree in Electrical Engineering or a comparable technical qualification* Professional experience in the planning and engineering of auxiliary power systems for proficiency in relevant engineering and calculation tools* Excellent written and verbal communication skills in German and English within international project environments* Structured, independent, and solution-oriented working approach, combined with strong teamwork and stakeholder management skills* Willingness to travel for project-related activities, including technical coordination, factory acceptance tests (FAT), and commissioning supportAbout the TeamOur Grid Technology division enables a reliable, sustainable, and digital grid. The power grid is the backbone of the energy transition. Siemens Energy offers a leading portfolio and solutions in HVDC transmission, grid stabilization and storage, high voltage switchgears and transformers, and digital grid technology.  Who is Siemens Energy? At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.      Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideoOur Commitment to Diversity Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences. Rewards/Benefits * In addition to an attractive remuneration package in line with the market, you can expect an attractive employer-financed company pension scheme* We also offer the opportunity to become a Siemens Energy shareholder* We offer our employees the opportunity to work flexibly and remotely, and our inspiring offices provide space for collaboration and creativity* The professional and personal development of our employees is very important to us.
